reason: overlay remove dirty-tree guard (#675): module-size 28123->28178 (+55), measured on the tree rebased onto ca89ca2 (#684). The growth is the fix and it is all in npm/src -- no new modules. overlay-commands.ts (+41) carries the guard itself: a RemoveOptions type, the two refusal branches (dirty, and unreadable treated as dirty because a clone whose git status cannot be read is not one to delete blind), the contract docblock stating why removal is refuse-by-default with --force as the explicit opt-in, and a rewritten `update` refusal message -- the old one advised `canary overlay remove` as the remedy, which this change turns into a dead end, so it now names --force. engine-checks.ts (+3) fixes the same newly-stale advice in the engine:overlay-clean doctor remedy; leaving either would have preserved the trap one hop further away. router.ts (+4) is --force parsing and the two usage strings. uninstall-scan.ts (+9) is the delegation to the shared workingTreeStatus, and it is the one place worth being blunt about: delegating made the file LONGER, not shorter. The shared GitRunner requires status: number, uninstall's returns number | null, so a 4-line adapter plus the comment documenting the null -> unreadable -> treated-as-dirty mapping costs more than the 5-line inline porcelain check it replaced. It buys a single source of truth for 'are local edits safe here', which is exactly what #675 was about, not brevity. The alternative -- widening the shared GitRunner's status to number | null -- was rejected rather than absorbed: it would push a nullable status onto all three existing consumers of workingTreeStatus to save four lines at one call site. Nothing was dropped to fit under this allowance and nothing avoidable is being allowed. No new architecture violations (newViolations: 0; one pre-existing violation is resolved), so violationIds is empty. Test growth (5 new node --test cases in overlay-remove/overlay-router/overlay-update, including the regression test that asserts an edited file's bytes survive a refused remove) is test code and not counted by module-size.
